# Cobra API Reference

> Complete bilingual API reference for github.com/spf13/cobra v1.10.2 — Command struct, lifecycle hooks, pflag & relational flag groups, PositionalArgs combinators, Shell Completion V2, ActiveHelp, and cobra/doc generators.

- [Command Execution, Resolution & I/O Streams](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/02_lifecycle_and_execution.html): This chapter documents the execution entrypoints, command-tree resolution algorithms (Find vs. Traverse), global lifecycle callbacks (OnInitialize…
- [pflag.FlagSet Accessors, Annotations & Relational Flag Groups](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/03_flags_and_flag_groups.html): Cobra integrates tightly with github.com/spf13/pflag (POSIX/GNU-style flags) to provide hierarchical flag inheritance (PersistentFlags vs. Flags), scoped…
- [PositionalArgs Type & Built-in Validator Combinators](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/04_positional_args.html): The args.go source file (L22-L132) defines the cobra.PositionalArgs function type, nine exported positional argument validators and combinators, the…
- [05. Dynamic Completions, Directives & ActiveHelp](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/05_completions_and_directives.html): The dynamic completion engine in github.com/spf13/cobra (completions.go and active_help.go) enables CLI applications to compute context-aware tab completions…
- [06. Shell Completion Script Generators](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/06_shell_script_generators.html): Cobra provides built-in autocompletion script generators for Bash (V2 and Legacy V1), Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell (completions.go, bash_completionsV2.go…
- [07. Help, Usage, Templates & Global Configuration](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/07_help_usage_and_templates.html): Cobra's help, usage, version, typo-suggestion, and global configuration subsystems (command.go and cobra.go) govern how CLI metadata is formatted, inherited…
- [08. Auto-Generated Documentation (cobra/doc)](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/en/08_doc_generation.html): Package github.com/spf13/cobra/doc inspects a *cobra.Command hierarchy—including command synopses, long descriptions, examples, local and inherited…
